proofs.text: Write `config.local.json` holding `{"existing": "keep"}`, then set the key `added` to `new`; verify the local file holds both `{"existing": "keep", "added": "new"}`

reasons: PROOF-9 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: A write preserves every key `config.local.json` already held

tests.body:
def test_preserves_existing_keys(self):
        local_path = os.path.join(self.purlin_dir, 'config.local.json')
        with open(local_path, 'w') as f:
            json.dump({"existing": "keep"}, f)
        update_config(self.project_root, "added", "new")
        with open(local_path) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        assert data == {"existing": "keep", "added": "new"}
tests.name: test_preserves_existing_keys
